result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make people much better at understanding one another—especially across deep disagreements. Not forcing everyone to agree, but helping people accurately see what others have experienced, what they fear, and what they value before judging them.

That single shift could make many other problems easier to solve: fewer conflicts driven by misperception, less loneliness, fairer institutions, and more cooperation on challenges no person or nation can tackle alone.
